title: Tea Cake
summary: Super light, buttery and airy cake which with the cinnamon...
extendedSummary: Super light, buttery and airy cake which with the cinnamon is such an immaculate combo. Absolutely must serve this with a cup of yorkshire tea and honey.

items: A few tbsps of melted butter

method: Preheat the oven to 180°C, and line a square baking tin with baking paper
Beat butter, sugar and vanilla together until light and creamy
Add eggs one at a time until fully incorporated, then sifted in flour and add milk (alternating between the two)
Beat batter for a few mins until smooth and light
Scoop batter into the baking tin, and bake for 35 mins or until it passes the skewer test
When out of the oven, melt some butter, and brush it over the cake, sprinkling over cinnamon at the end until - then divide into rectangular prisms
